name: Ehrat´s Backmanufaktur
kurzbeschreibung:
**Ehrat’s Backmanufaktur in Tirol** – where tradition meets craftsmanship in the heart of the Alps.

Discover authentic **Tiroler** bread, baked with passion in our historic stone oven. From rustic **Vinschgerl** to fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn**, every loaf tells a story of regional flavors.

Visit us in **Innsbruck**, **Landeck**, or **Imst**—where every bite connects you to the soul of **Tirol**.
